concepts.title: Events, current decisions and old records
concepts.text: A source creates an event; a collector receives selected events. Generate simulated event uses one supplied template. Accepted records remain historical evidence after settings change. Check configuration asks fresh positive AND negative cases, so old success or clearing a log cannot repair a broken policy.

concepts.title: Urgency runs toward zero
concepts.text: Severity 0 emergency, 1 alert, 2 critical, 3 error, 4 warning, 5 notice, 6 informational and 7 debug describe decreasing urgency. A threshold includes its number and all smaller numbers: warning 4 accepts 0 through 4, not 5 through 7. Off disables that output. The modeled process switch affects local and remote outputs; no console is modeled.

concepts.title: Local and remote have independent budgets
concepts.text: The local buffer and remote export use separate thresholds. A warning may belong locally while only errors and more urgent events go remote. Collector filtering happens after source filtering; a collector cannot recover an event the source did not export.

concepts.title: Facility is not the subsystem label
concepts.text: The event's LINK, AUTH or SYS label names its message subsystem. Export facility is a separate numeric category, 0 through 23. Local0 through local7 are facilities 16 through 23. Changing that source facility does not change LINK into another subsystem. A priority number is facility times 8 plus severity; this activity does not construct protocol packets.

concepts.title: Follow the delivery path
concepts.text: Check the source process, remote threshold and collector address, then supplied delivery availability and the collector's facility selector. The first refusal can hide another problem. An unavailable supplied path is fixed exercise evidence; editing policy cannot make it a real network connection. Collector selectors admit that facility at their threshold or more urgent.

concepts.title: Apply deliberately and protect the other work
concepts.text: Choose the source or collector, edit its native table, then Apply settings. Unapplied changes are saved drafts; Generate still uses applied policy. Protected policies must stay exactly as supplied. Practice uses different addresses and events. Fill example settings only fills its draft; Apply is separate. Reset example restores practice; main Reset requires confirmation. Neither is real-device undo.

scenarios.summary: Follow the refusal chain without pretending policy repairs connectivity.

Exclude notice/debug locally and at Operations. No event may be delivered to retired 10.215.0.120; its supplied path is unavailable. Keep BOTH collector policies exactly as supplied. Diagnose the source process and destination as well as filtering.

scenarios.title: Route categories without confusing subsystem labels
scenarios.summary: Repair collector selectors while the source identities and export policies remain fixed.
scenarios.objective: Keep both Cedar source policies EXACTLY unchanged. Operations 10.216.0.100 must receive access source 10.216.0.10's port-warning and authentication-error using its fixed facility 16. Audit 10.216.0.110 must receive audit source 10.216.0.20's same two event types using fixed facility 20. Neither collector receives the other source or either source's debug. Repair collector selectors; the LINK/AUTH message labels do not choose a destination facility.

scenarios.title: Hand over Operations without breaking Audit
scenarios.summary: Migrate two distinct urgency budgets while retaining a protected third pipeline.
scenarios.objective: Move Harbor access and branch exports to new Operations 10.217.0.110 using facility 22 or 23; neither may deliver to retired 10.217.0.100 or Audit. Access retains critical/error/warning locally and remotely, excluding notice/debug. Branch retains only critical/error locally and remotely, excluding warning/notice/debug. Keep audit source 10.217.0.30 and BOTH retired Operations and Audit collector policies EXACTLY unchanged; Audit must still accept its critical and reject its warning. Historical old-inbox rows may remain; current delivery decides completion.
